name: Hikikomori Sekai no Tantei Jikenbo Zero -Fight for the Past-
original_name: 引籠世界の探偵事件簿ZERO -FIght for the Past-
source:
Main character receives a prank-looking request from German police to catch the world's strongest killer. The culprit only targets famous military and martial artists around the world. Protagonist is announced as next victim, so he sets off with his robot maid partner to the island to make preparations and unravel the mystery.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到德国警方发出的恶作剧要求，要求抓捕世界上最强的杀手。罪魁祸首只针对世界各地著名的军事和武术家。主角被宣布为下一个受害者，于是他和他的机器人女仆搭档出发前往岛上做准备并解开谜团。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
